03 — Engineering approach

A useful instrument is a chain of decisions made visible.

I approach measurement software as a connected system: clarify what must be observed, make the acquisition trustworthy, expose the analysis, then leave an execution trail someone can understand and extend.

  1. 01

    Frame the measurement

    Define the signal, uncertainty and decisions that the system must support.

  2. 02

    Make capture dependable

    Coordinate devices, timing and data paths with failure modes in view.

  3. 03

    Turn data into insight

    Build analysis and interfaces that let engineers inspect, compare and act.

  4. 04

    Design for the next mode

    Keep the platform legible as hardware, tests and users change.
